name: knob-slider
title: Knob Slider
description: A circular knob edged with fine tick marks. Dragging around the ring turns a small triangle pointer and snaps the value to the nearest tick, while the big number rolls and blurs as it spins, then sharpens when it stops.
use: A single value should be set with a tactile rotary feel, such as volume or intensity.
avoid: It is mouse-only, with no wheel or keyboard input, and takes a large fixed square of space.
a11y: The dial has no slider role, aria-valuenow, keyboard control or focus ring, so it works only with a mouse. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large near-black circle on a black stage, ringed by dozens of short radial ticks. Inside sits a slightly lighter disc holding a very large white number, with a small grey triangle on the outer edge marking the current angle.
behaves: Pressing the dial jumps the value to that angle, then dragging sweeps the triangle around and snaps to one of seventy-two positions. While the pointer moves, the number blurs and rolls like a slot machine and clears as it settles.
customise: Value, change handler, minimum, maximum and diameter are props; the tick count, digit spring and blur rule are fixed in the file.
weight: light: One SVG tick ring and spring-animated digits that idle when the dial is not dragged.
